Market today: The mood for tech/chip names is cautious, driven by negative reactions to earnings (AMD) and investor concerns over high AI spending (SpaceX). This suggests a potential pullback in your concentrated sectors.

Your holdings: SOXL (-45.03%) and SPAL (-47.87%) are leveraged ETFs with significant drawdowns and "SELL"/"NEW" statuses, needing immediate attention. SMH (-9.53%) is also concerning given chip sector news. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Monitor for continued weakness in the broader chip sector and re-evaluate the stops on your leveraged positions.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your deeply underwater leveraged ETFs and stay vigilant on chip sector performance.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL given its deep drawdown and leveraged decay; adjust stop from 200 to a relevant level or exit.
Review SPAL, another leveraged ETF with a significant loss; set a realistic stop or consider reducing exposure.
Watch SMH closely; the AMD news suggests further weakness in the chip sector could push it lower.
